premise: Snail worries when Flower closes her petals at dusk; he keeps her company all night and sees her open again in the morning.
inspiration: Andersen's The Daisy, turned: the small watcher at the flower's side is rewarded, not forgotten, and the morning answers his worry.
lesson: Staying with a friend is a kind thing to do, even when you don't understand.
learning: Many flowers close their petals at night and open them in the morning

en-US.title: Flower Closes at Night
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7 22s} [softly] As the sun went down, {flower:enter} Flower {flower:pulse} began to fold her petals, one by one, {flower:face sleeping} until she was closed up tight. {snail:enter} {snail:face surprised} [gasps] Snail {snail:pulse} stared. Flower? Are you all right? But Flower didn't answer. She was asleep. {canvas:night 0.7 18s} {snail:face sad} [sad] Snail didn't know what to do. So he stayed. All night long he sat beside her, keeping her company. {sfx:crickets} The crickets sang. The stars came out. {snail:face sleeping} Snail's eyes grew heavy. Then the first bird sang. {sfx:bird solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} And very slowly, as the sun peeked over the hill, {flower:face happy} Flower opened {flower:glow} her petals again, wide and bright. {snail:face happy} [happily] Good morning, Snail! she said. You waited for me? {snail:live} Snail tucked into his shell, a little bit shy… then peeked out and looked around. Every flower in the meadow was opening. And {butterfly:enter} Butterfly {butterfly:float loop 0.3} came to say good morning too.

es-ES.title: Flor se cierra de noche
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7 22s} [softly] Cuando el sol se puso, {flower:enter} Flor {flower:pulse} empezó a plegar sus pétalos, uno a uno, {flower:face sleeping} hasta quedarse bien cerrada. {snail:enter} {snail:face surprised} [gasps] Caracol {snail:pulse} se la quedó mirando. ¿Flor? ¿Estás bien? Pero Flor no contestó. Estaba dormida. {canvas:night 0.7 18s} {snail:face sad} [sad] Caracol no sabía qué hacer. Así que se quedó. Toda la noche estuvo sentado a su lado, haciéndole compañía. {sfx:crickets} Cantaron los grillos. Salieron las estrellas. {snail:face sleeping} A Caracol se le cerraban los ojos. Entonces cantó el primer pájaro. {sfx:bird solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} Y muy despacito, mientras el sol asomaba por la colina, {flower:face happy} Flor abrió {flower:glow} otra vez sus pétalos, grandes y brillantes. {snail:face happy} [happily] ¡Buenos días, Caracol!, dijo. ¿Me has esperado? {snail:live} Caracol se metió en su concha, un poquito vergonzoso… luego asomó y miró a su alrededor. Todas las flores del prado se estaban abriendo. Y {butterfly:enter} Mariposa {butterfly:float loop 0.3} vino también a darle los buenos días.

crickets.prompt: soft night crickets in a meadow, calm and sleepy

bird.prompt: a single small bird singing the first gentle notes of dawn
